description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Parts' that renders a page with a list of spare parts. It includes static featured parts cards with images, descriptions, and specifications, as well as dynamic loading of parts data from an API. The component manages state for parts data and errors, implements intersection observer for animations, and provides placeholder imagery with guidance for final asset replacement.
